title: notice-route config
description: .config/notice-route/config.yaml under the home directory from the password database (HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME are not read; an unusable home directory is exit 2 with key home) plus config.d/*.yaml beside it in lexical order (rules and hooks.post-fail lists append; entries of destinations, quiet_hours, links.hosts and links.tickets merge by name; a rule name or entry name defined twice, or any other key defined in two files, is config_invalid). A drop-in that holds only rules is valid against this schema. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Files are parsed with a strict YAML loader (no anchors, aliases or explicit tags, no duplicate keys; yes, on and dates are strings). Constraints between keys (a rule's destinations exist, unique rule names, a quiet name exists, ranges of durations, retention of at least 1d, time zones, end different from start) are checked by the loader and by validate, not by this schema. Self-contained: no external references.

destination_name.description: A destination name: 1 to 32 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*.

duration.description: Seconds as a positive finite number, or a string matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms|s|m)? (no unit means seconds); zero is refused. Booleans are never accepted. Ranges are enforced by the loader and named in the key's description.

duration_long.description: As duration, plus the h and d suffixes; used only by the keys that name hours and days (retention.* and dedup_window). Ranges are enforced by the loader.

label.description: A key=value label, split at the first =. Key [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}; value 0 to 256 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._:/#@+=,-].

level.description: Ordered info < warn < action < error. The order matters to destination floors and quiet hours; the notifiers do not use it.

quiet_name.description: The name of a quiet_hours window (the destination name grammar).

labels.description: All must be present among the notification's labels.

where.description: A map from payload field path to a string, integer or boolean; every pair must equal (same JSON type and value). Applies to hook payloads only; a condition that does not apply to a shape never matches it.

rule_match.description: All present conditions must hold. An empty match matches everything. source and labels apply to both shapes; hook, repo and where to hook payloads only; level_min to channel notices only (a notice without level counts as info) and may not be combined with hook, repo or where. In where, an integer is a number written without a fraction or exponent, so 1.0 never equals 1.

rule_name.description: A rule name: 1 to 64 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*.

wildcard.description: An exact value of 1 to 256 characters, or a value ending in one * (prefix match; a lone * matches any present value). A * is allowed only as the last character (** or an inner * is config_invalid); matching is case-sensitive.

enabled.description: false makes send exit 22 (disabled) before reading state and flush exit 22 doing nothing.

prefixItems.description: An absolute path (load error otherwise). At each call the router resolves it with realpath (following symlinks); the resolved file and every directory of the resolved path must be owned by the user or root and not group- or world-writable, and the file must have no setuid or setgid bit (else exec_failed). The resolved path is executed.

cmd.description: An argv list of at most 32 elements of at most 4096 characters; no shell. cmd[0] is absolute; the ownership and mode check runs at each call on the resolved path. The notifier's --config <path> belongs here. A script that wraps the notifier must exec it. An element equal to send, --stdin-json, --json, --actor or --dedupe-key, or starting with one of those flags and =, is config_invalid.

timeout.description: The notifier's own timeout or more (the router does not pass it). Range 1s to 120s. The kill deadline is this plus 10 s.

quiet.description: Name of a quiet_hours window; none by default.

max_per_hour.description: Notifier calls claimed per UTC clock hour, counted separately for error and for the other levels (a digest counts in its highest class and is never held); 0 means no cap.

env.description: The only variables passed to the notifier besides the fixed set (PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, WSL_INTEROP, WSL_DISTRO_NAME), which may not be named. The names are trusted configuration. An unset or empty variable counts as unset: send queues the notification for flush, and flush does not call the destination.

enabled.description: When false the destination is skipped with outcome disabled.

fallback.description: Name of another destination (the name grammar of a destination) that receives a notification when a delivery to this one ends failed. It must be defined, not this destination and not part of a cycle, and a chain has at most 3 hops; those cross-references are checked by the router, not by this schema. None by default.

destinations.description: Named channels and the command that reaches each; at most 32.

timezone.description: Required IANA zone name; no default and no reading of the system zone. Loaded only from the system database; localtime, posixrules, Factory and any name that fails to load are config_invalid.

days.description: The days on which the window starts; default every day.

end.description: HH:MM; earlier than start means the window ends the next day; equal to start is config_invalid (checked by the loader).

hosts.description: <host>[:<port>] (lowercase, the pr grammar; a port is 1 to 65535, checked by the loader) to forge type; builds pr_url.

additionalProperties.description: An https base URL ending in /, in the literal URL grammar of a rule's link (port 1 to 65535, checked by the loader); the ticket key is appended.

tickets.description: Ticket site name to base URL; builds ticket_url.

links.description: The router's own link tables; the only source of links. Hold only host names and base URLs of your own systems.

name.description: Required, unique among rules and across drop-ins (uniqueness is checked by the loader).

drop.description: When true, no other key except name and match is allowed; the outcome is dropped with reason rule_drop, one history row without a destination.

notify.description: Destination names, each defined (checked by the loader). Required unless drop.

level.description: The final level when set; else the channel notice's own level, else info. Required unless drop or match.level_min (a rule that can match a hook payload must set a level).

title.description: Template for the title, optional; needs message. A token renders a payload value only when it is plain (a number, a boolean or a string matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/#-]{0,255}); other text renders empty in a title. The rendered title is sanitized and cut to 256 characters.

message.description: Template for the message; a rule without message is a pass-through rule and must have match.level_min. Text values render only through include_text. The rendered message is sanitized and cut to 4000 characters.

link.description: Exactly {{pr_url}}, exactly {{ticket_url}}, or a literal URL https://<host>[:<port>][/<path>] of at most 1024 characters (path characters [A-Za-z0-9._~/%?=&+-]; a port is 1 to 65535, checked by the loader). A link that renders empty means no link.

dedup_window.description: Window of the repeat check; range 1s to 24h; default the defaults.dedup_window key (10m).

include_text.description: Opt-in for untrusted text in the message: token paths. The text of a listed token renders only when the payload has reads_third_party false and tainted false as booleans. An entry that no message token uses has no effect.

rules.description: Ordered; the first rule whose match holds decides everything.

dedup_window.description: The default for a rule's dedup_window; range 1s to 24h.

lock_wait.description: How long a send polls for a destination's lock; range 1s to 60s.

history.description: Age at which prune deletes history rows; at least 1d (checked by the loader).

event_ids.description: Age at which prune forgets event ids; at least 1d (checked by the loader).

cmd.description: Run via sh -c in its own process group; JSON payload on stdin.

async.description: Do not wait for the hook before flush exits (the router runs post-fail hooks from flush only).

hooks.description: Hook entries per hook as in the design guide: exactly cmd, timeout and async; lists from config.d append.

env_file.description: Absolute path of a mode-0600 file the cron lines source and export (set -a).
